description: This test file contains unit tests for various functions related to context window management and configuration in a larger AI/ML SDK. It tests functions like applyDiscoveredContextWindows, applyConfiguredContextWindows, createSessionManagerRuntimeRegistry, and resolveContextTokensForModel, verifying behavior with different configurations and model identifiers.

methods.name: applyDiscoveredContextWindows
methods.description: Updates cache entries with context window sizes based on discovered models, preferring minimal context window for duplicate model IDs.

methods.name: applyConfiguredContextWindows
methods.description: Updates cache based on a configuration provided for models, respecting provider-specific and bare model ID entries, and avoiding overwriting discovery entries.

methods.name: createSessionManagerRuntimeRegistry
methods.description: Creates a registry object for storing, retrieving, and clearing arbitrary data associated with session objects by object identity.

methods.name: resolveContextTokensForModel
methods.description: Resolves and determines the number of context tokens to use for a specific model based on configuration, provider, and special conditions like 'context1m'.
